نشترك (form VIII)
# نَشْتَرِكُ (naštariku) /naʃ.ta.ri.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَكَ (ištaraka)
# نَشْتَرِكَ (naštarika) /naʃ.ta.ri.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَرَكَ (ištaraka)
# نَشْتَرِكْ (naštarik) /naʃ.ta.rik/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْتَرَكَ (ištaraka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
